If you want the **best online courses** for shadow work and spiritual practice, the strongest options in your results are **Jung Platform’s Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work**, **Charlie Morley’s Embracing the Shadow Course on Awake Academy**, and **ManTalks’ Shadow Course** because they are explicitly structured around guided shadow integration rather than generic self-help.[2][16][15]

For a quick, practical shortlist:

- **Jung Platform — Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work**: best if you want a more classical Jungian approach and a course grounded in shadow patterns and repeated behaviors.[2]
- **Awake Academy — Embracing The Shadow with Charlie Morley**: best if you want a transformational, spiritually oriented course with a guided process.[16]
- **ManTalks — Shadow Course**: best if you want an 8-week guided process focused on facing and integrating the shadow.[15]
- **Sacred Humans — Inner Healing Shadow Work Course**: best if you want a broader “healing + spirituality + relationships” package, since it includes emotional regulation, spiritual awakening, and mindfulness themes.[14]
- **Catharine Liggett — Shadow Work 101**: best if you prefer a live 5-week Zoom format with practical techniques.[6]

If you want lower-cost or self-paced options, several Udemy courses appear relevant, including **Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self**, **The Shadow Work Course (Carl Jung Psychology)**, and **Shadow Work Course and Workbook**.[3][7][11]

A simple way to choose:
- Choose **Jung Platform** if you want theory plus deep self-observation.[2]
- Choose **Awake Academy** if spiritual transformation is your main goal.[16]
- Choose **ManTalks** if you want structured guidance over several weeks.[15]
- Choose **Sacred Humans** if you want shadow work combined with emotional healing and mindfulness.[14]
- Choose **Udemy** if you want a more affordable, flexible entry point.[3][7][11]
